title: InkQuest — Quest Definition
description: Format v3.1. Defines a quest for the InkQuest (TravelCore Questing) Minecraft mod.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference — used by IDEs for validation and autocompletion.

description.description: Optional description shown in the quest book.

icon.description: Item or block identifier used as the quest icon. Default: inkquest:default

index.description: Sort order in the quest book. Default: 0

repeatable.description: If true, the quest can be given again after completion — progress is reset automatically. Default: false

pin_mode.description: Pinning behaviour when the quest is given. auto — pin if nothing else is pinned; force — always pin; off — never pin. Default: auto

after.description: Dependency groups. AND within a group, OR between groups. The quest unlocks when all quests in at least one group are completed successfully.

require.description: Additional unlock conditions checked together with 'after'. Ignored if 'after' is absent.

tasks.description: Map of task ID → task definition. Keys are arbitrary identifiers used in 'stages' and condition references.

stages.description: Ordered list of stages. Each stage is an array of task IDs: the first is the required task, the rest are optional.

text.description: Minecraft text component — plain string or a JSON text object.

questRequirement.description: Extra conditions evaluated once when a dependency quest completes.

tags.description: Scoreboard tags the player must have.

predicate.description: Minecraft predicate evaluated against the player.

description.description: Optional description shown in the quest book.

condition.description: Automatic completion conditions for this task.

on.description: Lifecycle hooks — functions and scoreboard tags triggered at task events.

buttons.description: Optional manual completion buttons shown under the task in the quest book. Order in array is irrelevant — UI always renders success → failure → skip. Duplicates are collapsed (with a server-log warning).

success.description: Condition that, when met, completes the task as SUCCESS.

failure.description: Condition that, when met, completes the task as FAILURE.

load.description: Fired once when the task becomes active.

tick.description: Fired every tick while the task is active.

pinned_tick.description: Fired every tick while the task is active and its quest is pinned.

unload.description: Fired once when the task stops being active.

success.description: Fired when the task completes as SUCCESS.

failure.description: Fired when the task completes as FAILURE.

tags.description: Scoreboard tags to add to the player.

predicate.description: Minecraft predicate to evaluate against the player.

objective.description: Scoreboard objective name. Created automatically if it does not exist.

from.description: Starting value. Default: 0. If from > to the condition counts down (score <= to). Sets the progress bar baseline.

to.description: Target value. Ascending: score >= to. Descending: score <= to (when from > to).

reset.description: If true (default), sets the player's score to 'from' when the task loads. Set to false to track an existing score without resetting it.

objective.description: Scoreboard objective name (criterion always dummy). Created automatically if it does not exist.

from.description: Starting value for direction and progress baseline. Default: 0.

to.description: Target value. Ascending: score >= to. Descending: score <= to (when from > to).

conditions.description: At least one sub-condition must be met.

status.description: Expected completion status of the optional tasks. Omit to accept any terminal status.

min.description: Minimum number of matching optional tasks. Omit to require all optional tasks in the stage.
